problem: Compute optimum energy to explicit additive error for an explicit rational Pauli Hamiltonian
input_model: Full public Pauli words and rational coefficients, independent symplectic labels, verified predecessor-uniform order; no hidden oracle or advice
proposed_mechanism: Known efficient HDQI pilot MPS plus reversible full-rank linear syndrome inversion and polynomial filtering
intended_advantage: A polynomial algorithm would matter only if a substantially harder matched classical optimum-energy problem survived
decisive_classical_falsifier: Exact radius expression R<-R+abs(c) or R<-sqrt(R^2+c^2) gives a polynomial-time additive-energy approximation
proof_obligations: Verify full symplectic column rank on the actual input
Find and verify a genuine predecessor-uniform order
Justify independent commuting sign sectors and symmetric spectra, rather than assume them from a graph alone
Use controlled bit precision and charge rank/order work
Do not turn energy solvability into Gibbs/output-sampling dequantization
Do not apply the recurrence to dependent labels
experiments: Native Hamiltonian diagonalization and executed canonical ground-state residual versus the scalar optimum
Exact rational outward enclosures versus independent high-precision scalar evaluation
Dependent commuting triangle must reject: actual ground energy -1 instead of incorrect -3
Non-predecessor graph must reject as unsupported rather than label it hard
